articles.summary: SINGAPORE, Feb. 14, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - BrilliA Inc (“BRIA” or “the Company”), a one-stop service cross-border solution provider for ladies' intimate apparel brands, announced that it has established a cooperation framework with the iconic French luxury lingerie brand Maison Lejaby, with an anticipated supply value of up to €10 million based on projected needs. articles.title: BrilliA Establishes Cooperation Framework with Top French Luxury Brand and Lands European Introduction for In-House DIANA Brand
